Looking at the data, the only change in the cooling setpoints is that Core_bottom (F2Z01) dropped ~1C around late May/early June, while the other core zones (F3Z01, F4Z01) — which share the same HVAC building schedule — remained essentially unchanged (25.185 → 25.248).

If this were a building-wide **schedule change**, all zones sharing that schedule would be affected. The fact that only this one zone's effective setpoint changed (and only its measured temperature) supports a per-zone local change rather than a global schedule change.
